heading: What happens after you get in touch.
lede: Deal by deal, so you decide on each property rather than on a commitment made a year earlier.

steps.title: Introduction
steps.body: A call to cover your objectives, check size, hold-period tolerance, and whether this strategy actually fits what you are trying to do.

steps.title: Qualification
steps.body: Accredited investor status confirmed and documentation completed before any specific offering material is shared.

steps.title: Deal package
steps.body: You receive the underwriting model, the renovation budget, market and rent comparables, and the full offering documents — and review them with your own advisors.

steps.title: Subscription
steps.body: Subscribe if it fits, and fund ahead of closing. Passing on a deal has no effect on future ones.

steps.title: Ownership
steps.body: Quarterly reporting on operations, renovation progress and distributions, plus an annual K-1. Direct access to the sponsor, not an investor-relations queue.
